channel.title: Outlay
channel.description: Open U.S. federal grants, sorted by deadline, amount and who can apply — with plain-English guides to applying.

item.title: How to Write Grants for Nonprofits: Federal Proposal Guide
item.description: Learn how to write grants for nonprofits the way federal reviewers score them: needs statement, goals, budget narrative, and Grants.gov submission steps.

item.title: Small Business Grants for Women: Federal Options (2026)
item.description: Small business grants for women from the federal government are limited. Learn which SBA programs, SBIR/STTR awards, and WOSB certification apply to you.

item.title: How to Apply for Grants for Small Business (2026 Guide)
item.description: How to apply for grants for small business in 2026: set up SAM.gov, get your UEI, register on Grants.gov, filter by eligibility, and submit before the deadline.

item.title: How to Check SAM.gov Registration Status (Step by Step)
item.description: Learn how to check SAM.gov registration status in Workspace or the public entity search, what Active, Inactive and Submitted mean, and what to do next.
